info_item: Claude Code is an agentic coding CLI tool built by Anthropic that lives in the terminal, understands a full codebase, and autonomously executes tasks, including reading files and running commands, via natural language. It was created by Boris Cherny in September 2024 as a solo prototype and grew to a full product team by 2025, reaching GA with version 1.0.0 in May 2025. It is distributed as an npm package and also integrates with VS Code, JetBrains, a Desktop app, a web browser, and GitHub Actions. [q-1]
